name: Lübeck
author: pierreggt
description: Map of Lübeck, Germany, from the city center to Lübeck Airport, spanning the surrounding Schleswig-Holstein towns (Bad Schwartau, Stockelsdorf, Ratekau, and others). Residential population comes from the official 2022 census 100m population grid (Zensus 2022). Real German labor-market statistics (official employment counts and municipality-to-municipality commuter flows) anchor 3 of the surrounding satellite municipalities; Lübeck city itself relies on a POI-density gravity model.
data_source: Zensus 2022 (Destatis), Beschäftigtenstatistik BA + Pendlerrechnung der Länder (regionalstatistik.de/GENESIS-Online) for satellite towns, gravity model for Lübeck itself, OSM, Overture Maps
